raisedIn: Washington Heights, Manhattan, New York City
background: Born and raised in Washington Heights, Manhattan, in a Dominican Jewish family; his mother coordinates a neighborhood clinic, his father is a public-school custodian, and Spanish is the language of home.
regionalHistory: His maternal grandparents descended from refugees who rebuilt their lives in Sosúa before moving to New York; his father's family has deep Dominican roots and arrived in the 1990s.
culturalBaseline: Reconstructionist and bilingual; holiday traditions, community history projects, and a mixed-faith extended family shape his practice.
sensitivities: Latino Jews treated as an exception
